text: i can just restart the app. its one small edit its not the end of the world. but the part where i cant rename / remove names from this face list is a problem tho u may have fixed it
resolution: Built rename and remove for semantic regions — naming had been a one-way door, so a mistyped or repurposed name was permanent and the user was left with no way to clear a table they had outgrown. New host door __mesh_semantic_region_edit(region, remove, tableJson): rename lands the caller's rewritten table with face membership untouched, while remove additionally clears every face wearing that region back to unnamed. Removal clears region AND instance together because model_source rejects a row carrying an instance without a region, and children of a removed region are orphaned to root instead of dangling at a dead parent; either edit is one journal step so Ctrl+Z restores it. The NAMES rows now carry inline rename (Enter commits, Escape cancels) and a remove verb, each reporting its outcome on the shell status line — a refusal that says nothing would be the same dead end as having no verb at all. Renaming onto another region's existing name is refused rather than silently minting a duplicate row, since that is a merge the user should ask for deliberately. The Agent Seat gets region-edit for parity and the skill documents both it and select-audit. rjit ship editor builds clean.
